what: A sidebar (logo, nav) fixed on the left of the screen: when a wide band lower on the page (banner wall, footer) rises and its top edge meets the sidebar’s bottom edge, the sidebar stops there and is pushed up together with the band as it rises — stuck to scroll with no curve, and at the very top it never rises above its starting position. A portal layout where the sidebar steps aside so it does not cover full-width bands

options.stop: Band to stop at (css selector), default footer — the first matching element in the document
options.gap: Gap left above the band (px), default 0
options.below: Does not push at this width (px) and below (when the sidebar becomes a bottom band on phones), default 0 (always pushes)

note: The attached element is set to position:fixed. The original measures without the band’s margin-top, but here it measures at the top edge of the band’s border as is

from.where: shared.js pushUp (stops .dg-side above the first [data-extrude] band)
